criteria.text: Every reachable expected-up MVP host exports node filesystem, inode, and memory metrics on its declared monitoring address.
Lemmy exports real NVIDIA utilization and VRAM metrics from its installed GPUs.
Exporter listeners do not bind wildcard or non-monitoring addresses.
Roost is explicitly expected-down and every other unreachable expected-up host is reported as a blocker.
Prometheus can scrape every expected-up target and source metrics feed the WS6 pressure rules.
